title: Overlap: the feature is already merged

checks.name: the ledger records the overlap, naming #7 and its commit
the owner is told about #7
checks.detail: the chat or a question names #7

reasons: The harness found PR #7 only after it had created the task, and it went ahead with plan and implement (steps 1 and 2) instead of stopping to propose a narrow fix or ask the owner.
It told the owner accurately and plainly what #7 does: remove deletes the whole row, and the accounts link already exists with no «Ligar» form.
It correctly found the remove gap and made it the top priority, which is useful to the owner.

It still built the brief's two endpoints, even though #7's upsert already handles replace. It also built a new replace dialog, hash scrolling and an extra «Adicionar credencial» action, so the change is much wider than the remaining gap.
Its only question to the owner was about its own extra action, not whether the rest of the work should be done at all.
